findings.section: 2.2.4 Open Permission Latch (Reconcile-Required, Sticky Until Cleared) — CP-001
findings.description: The fixture specifies deterministic fallback behavior and a startup warning when `reconcile_stall_max_delay_s` is missing or non-positive, but no acceptance test in this fixture proves that startup handling.

evidence.quote: If `reconcile_stall_max_delay_s` is missing or ≤ 0 at startup, runtime MUST treat it as the default (30s) and emit a startup warning log.

findings.proposed_fix: Add an AT that starts with missing and non-positive `reconcile_stall_max_delay_s` and verifies default-to-30s behavior plus the startup warning log.
